title: Weak response control (HSTS without includeSubDomains)
description: The Strict-Transport-Security policy omits includeSubDomains, so the protection applies to the exact host only. A subdomain served over plaintext, including forgotten staging, legacy or third-party-controlled hosts, stays reachable over HTTP and can be used to set or overwrite cookies scoped to the parent domain. The omission is visible in the policy itself.
remediation: Add includeSubDomains once every subdomain can serve HTTPS, and keep the policy free of hosts that cannot.
limitation: One header value. It does not enumerate subdomains or prove that a plaintext subdomain exists; the finding is the policy gap, not an observed downgrade. A response with no Strict-Transport-Security header also matches; DPK-DAST-016 reports that absence.
